images.image_prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable, dominant protagonist, one decisive action. A vast sunset Western canyon town built as a stylized film backlot erupts from a museum painting through practical projection inside a backstage movie studio disaster set. The central samurai-era courtyard guardian is an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. The cat shows enormous open-mouth yawn and performs leaning far over a ledge, safely supported by invisible rigging, pressing the ancient paw-sized stone key into a glowing floor lock. A black supporting cat, the villain is a random supporting cat double agent, changes sides and pushes the key forward. The visible outcome is the escape route opens beneath one decisive paw, revealing a bright safe passage, not a repeated event. Extreme low-angle viewpoint, 14mm lens, sharp cat and key, deep focus on canyon silhouette, warm sunset rim light, dust, projected paint spill, readable scale, realistic paws, whiskers, shadows and physical contact. No logos, no text, no watermark, no famous artwork, no exact character or costume copy, no danger, no injury, no cartoon, no illustration, no 3D render, no duplicate limbs.
Required assigned visual details: Western canyon showdown; Museum painting escape; extreme low-angle heroic frame.
